title: Among all drivers who recorded the fastest lap in any edition of the Spanis
question: Among all drivers who recorded the fastest lap in any edition of the Spanish Grand Prix (i.e., the driver with the minimum lap time in that year’s race), find the youngest one and return their full name, nationality, and the year of the race.

prediction.sql:
WITH spanish_races AS (
    SELECT XCL_065 AS race_id, XCL_066 AS race_year
    FROM races
    WHERE XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_043 AS race_id,
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lt.XCL_043
            ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM lapTimes lt
    INNER JOIN spanish_races sr ON lt.XCL_043 = sr.race_id
    WHERE lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest_lap_drivers AS (
    SELECT
        fl.race_id,
        fl.driver_id,
        sr.race_year
    FROM fastest_laps fl
    INNER JOIN spanish_races sr ON fl.race_id = sr.race_id
    WHERE fl.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    fld.race_year
FROM fastest_lap_drivers fld
INNER JOIN drivers d ON fld.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1
